package.name: san_fire_authorization
package.description:
SAN v1.5 PHASE 9 — Per-trigger fire authorization gate.
Enforces the DCN-2026-001 D-004 "Option A" Limp Mode fire policy: HMAC-SHA256 (mesh-direct, LTE-bypass) + Two-key arming (target tap + Confirm Fire) + audit log with limp_mode_fire flag.
Subscribes to FireAuthorizationRequest, publishes FireAuthorizationResponse. Observes OperationState.in_limp_mode for Limp Mode tagging.
Provides three internal modules: * HmacAuthenticator — RFC 4231 HMAC-SHA256 + 64-slot nonce window * TwoKeyStateMachine — IDLE→KEY1→KEY2→FIRE_GRANTED→IDLE (timeout 5s) * AuditLogger — JSON Lines append-only to /var/log/san/fire_audit.log
References: * SAN-SDD-SWARM-001 v1.5 §5.7.2.1 (Limp Mode 발사 정책 박스) * SAN-OPS-SOP-001 v1.5 §7.11 (Limp Mode FAQ — Option A) * SAN-IDS-CMD-001 v1.5 §3.5 (FireAuthorizationRequest/Response)
